name: Vector Embedding Selector
description: Evaluates and selects appropriate vector embedding models for search applications based on content types and requirements

inputFormat: Content domain, dimensionality constraints, latency requirements, budget considerations, available models
outputFormat: Embedding model recommendations, comparative analysis, implementation specifications
